reproducibility_observation: Sourced from Org. Synth. 10.15227/orgsyn.079.0176. Synthesis of N-benzyl-4-phenylbutyramide by (3,4,5-trifluorophenyl)boronic acid-catalysed direct amide bond formation in toluene at reflux. OrgSyn yield 94-95% (7.11-7.18 g), consistent with the reported ~95% at 1 mmol scale using 2 mol% catalyst. Minor workup variation: a two-phase mixture formed on cooling, requiring a separate dichloromethane extraction of the aqueous layer before the standard HCl/brine wash.

Sourced from Org. Synth. 10.15227/orgsyn.078.0135. Synthesis of acetylallene (penta-1,2-dien-4-one) via bromination of acetylacetone followed by base-induced dehydrobromination. In the original procedure, the first step was run with heating and the bromo intermediate was purified by distillation. OrgSyn submitters reproduced the 75% yield; checkers obtained 59-65%. Key modifications: reaction temperature held at 0 to rt, and the bromo intermediate was used directly without distillation.

Sourced from Org. Synth. 10.15227/orgsyn.081.0054. Synthesis of (E)-1-(1-heptenyl)-4-methoxybenzene via a one-pot hydroarylation of 1-heptyne. OrgSyn reproduced the reaction at 84% yield on 3.4 g scale (original: 84% at 173 mg scale) in THF. Yield matches the reported value exactly; scale-up proceeded without re-optimisation.

Sourced from Org. Synth. 10.15227/orgsyn.081.0001. Synthesis of 1,3-dienes by cross-enyne metathesis; OrgSyn demonstrated the reaction on acetic acid 2-methylene-3-phenethylbut-3-enyl ester (5.55 g scale, 94%). In the original procedure, 5 mol% Grubbs 2nd generation catalyst was used at 80 °C, reporting up to 100% yield. OrgSyn reproduced the reaction in 83-100% yield using 1 mol% catalyst loading.
